# Rantt

> > Rantt is a community-driven platform combining social networking with political commentary and investigative journalism on Trump administration, Russia interference, and grassroots activism.

Rantt is a social media platform for communities with iOS/Android apps and Stripe payment integration, founded by Kaz Weida. The site features in-depth political analysis, weekly Trump presidency breakdowns, and coverage of the resistance movement and social media activism.

## Key Topics

- Donald Trump
- Russia Investigation
- Trump Administration
- Political Analysis
- Social Media Activism
- 2016 Election
- White House Chaos
- Michael Flynn
- Vladimir Putin
- Trump Resistance
- GOP Politics
- Media Criticism
- Healthcare Policy
- Twitter
- Community Platform

## Trump Administration & Russia Investigation

- [Compromised By Money Laundering, Trump Was The Perfect Candidate For Putin](https://rantt.com/compromised-by-money-laundering-trump-was-the-perfect-candidate-for-putin): Trump-Russia collusion and money laundering investigation analysis
- [U.S. Officials: Putin Personally Directed Russia's Interference In Our Democracy](https://rantt.com/u-s-officials-putin-personally-directed-russias-interference-in-our-democracy): Russian election interference investigation and Putin's role
- [The Chaos President And The Myth Of The John Kelly Reset](https://rantt.com/the-chaos-president-and-the-myth-of-the-john-kelly-reset): Political analysis of Trump administration chaos and Kelly's role
- [Comey, Rogers, House Democrats And One Republican—The Only Adults At The Russia Hearing](https://rantt.com/comey-rogers-house-democrats-one-republican%e2%80%8a-%e2%80%8athe-only-adults-at-the-russia-hearing): Analysis of Russia investigation hearing and testimonies
- [Jill Stein Talked To Us About Michael Flynn, That RT Dinner, And The Recount Money](https://rantt.com/jill-stein-talked-to-us-about-michael-flynn-that-rt-dinner-and-the-recount-money): Interview with Jill Stein on election recount and Russia connections

## Weekly Trump Presidency Breakdowns

- [A Complete Breakdown Of Donald Trump's 28th Unpresidented Week As POTUS](https://rantt.com/a-complete-breakdown-of-donald-trumps-28th-unpresidented-week-as-potus): Weekly Trump presidency breakdown covering Mueller investigation
- [A Complete Breakdown Of Donald Trump's 33rd Unpresidented Week As POTUS](https://rantt.com/a-complete-breakdown-of-donald-trumps-33rd-unpresidented-week-as-potus): Weekly Trump presidency recap covering North Korea tensions
- [A Complete Breakdown Of Donald Trump's 42nd Unpresidented Week As POTUS](https://rantt.com/a-complete-breakdown-of-donald-trumps-42nd-unpresidented-week-as-potus): Weekly Trump presidency analysis covering foreign policy

## Political Analysis & Policy

- [Donald Trump And Republicans Have Already Lost On Healthcare](https://rantt.com/donald-trump-and-republicans-have-already-lost-on-healthcare): Healthcare policy debate and ACA repeal opposition analysis
- [Trump Lets Puerto Ricans Know That He Views Them As Second Class Citizens](https://rantt.com/trump-lets-puerto-ricans-know-that-he-views-them-as-second-class-citizens): Trump's response to Hurricane Maria in Puerto Rico analyzed
- [Texas GOP Will Use A Majority Latino City To Push Anti Latino Policies](https://rantt.com/texas-gop-will-use-a-majority-latino-city-to-push-anti-latino-policies): Texas GOP immigration policy debate in San Antonio analyzed
- [The Fallacy That Ate The GOP](https://rantt.com/the-fallacy-that-ate-the-gop): GOP ideology criticism and wealth inequality analysis
- [Why Conservative Women Vote For Alleged Sexual Abusers](https://rantt.com/why-women-vote-for-sexual-predators): Analysis of conservative women voters and Roy Moore allegations
